author: KEXP
description: Through deadpan humor and disco-punk loops, Bristol-based duo Getdown Services ignite the KEXP Live Room in our latest in-studio session. With host Troy Nelson, the pair share a high-octane performance of "Dog Dribble" and more.
title: Getdown Services performs "Dog Dribble" & more Live on KEXP
